dimensions.question: Can a first-time reader say who Pujan is and what he builds after twenty seconds on the page?
Does each featured project name a concrete problem and a concrete mechanism instead of a category?
Is every claim on the page traceable to a public repository, a commit, or a recorded owner decision?
Do the headings, bold anchors and link text alone tell the story of the page?
Does each image carry one idea, keep its subject visible, and keep its title and subtitle legible?
Does the page and its HTML tour stay readable at 390, 768 and 1440 pixel widths?

decision_rule: Accept only when claim_safety passes and no weighted dimension is below 3/5; human review can override model scores with a recorded reason.
